= Systems Analysis Methodology =

Systems analysis examines complex systems by identifying components, relationships, and emergent properties:

== Component Identification ==
Map all relevant entities within system boundaries. Distinguish core from peripheral elements.

== Relationship Mapping ==
Document interactions between components. Classify as causal, correlational, or constitutive.

== Feedback Loop Detection ==
Identify positive and negative feedback loops. Assess loop stability and time constants.

== Emergence Assessment ==
Identify properties that emerge from component interactions. Distinguish epistemic from ontological emergence.

== Boundary Critique ==
Examine how system boundaries affect analysis. Consider boundary changes and their implications.
</onlyinclude>
